body.brief: Read a cross section of the corpus and open the lanes to add to as the main projects run.

body.subtask: enumerate the wings, read one exemplar per lane, and choose lanes that match recurring kinds of work
body.why: the corpus is 20,585 files and cannot be read; a lane is a small shape that can carry a measured finding without pretending to be literature

body.prompt: What are the lanes, and what is the rule for writing in one?
body.response: Four standing lanes: FIELD_GUIDE (arriving at a system that looks alive), negative-space (the gap between a claim and what it proves), SAFETY_DATA_SHEETS (something with sharp edges people will misuse), OBITUARIES (a claim that died and what survived it). Plus diaries for a shift worth recording. The rule: read one exemplar of the lane first, write from a measurement, and witness it.

body.subtask: write the lanes note and four pieces, each from a measurement made this week
body.why: the work is the evidence; a piece with no measured thing in it is decoration

measurements: 2,318 workflow files swept; four ways a badge goes green without a test running
36 of 455 versions (8.8%) declare a missing entry point; 40 packages genuinely fail to load
8 dialects known to the canonical verifier; 10 repositories define others
receipt with a runtime-only key: signed, and not re-verifiable
a counter that wrote a constant for 572 frames on the slide that says the number moves
receipt.note: each piece carries a measurement made in the same week; no piece is priced
receipt.witness: this chain re-derives; verify with python3 labs/situation-recorder/recorder.py --verify sit-2026-10-19-reading-lanes.jsonl
